policy_rows.selected: {"consequence":"The suggested start follows the visitor’s stated curiosity.","decision":"How should visitors choose a starting room?","mechanism":"Reception asks about visitors’ interests before pointing out a starting room on the map."}

{"consequence":"The group makes a clear collective choice within a limited set.","decision":"How should a short guided visit choose its emphasis?","mechanism":"The guide offers two themes for the short visit and lets the group choose between them."}

{"consequence":"Visitors compare examples before reading the connecting explanation.","decision":"How should written labels connect related objects?","mechanism":"Individual labels ask a shared question, and a final label draws together the related objects."}

{"consequence":"The pause can address shared concerns together.","decision":"How should visitors collect questions for a volunteer?","mechanism":"Visitors write question cards before the discussion pause, and the volunteer groups similar questions."}

{"consequence":"Advice follows people already moving through the museum.","decision":"How should crowded rooms influence suggested routes?","mechanism":"Room volunteers offer route changes directly to visitors while reception keeps the map available."}

{"consequence":"The suggested visit begins with the visitor’s interests.","decision":"How should a visitor with little time plan a visit?","mechanism":"Visitors select highlights from the guide sheet, and reception helps trim them to the available time."}

{"consequence":"Visitors can keep the same contact through the beginning of the visit.","decision":"How should volunteers divide interpretation and reception?","mechanism":"Each volunteer welcomes a small group at reception and continues with its interpretation questions."}

{"consequence":"The narrative provides context for the object.","decision":"How should visitors encounter a local story?","mechanism":"Visitors read the story before seeing the object and answering the reflection question."}

{"consequence":"Initial noticing is left open before a focused reflection.","decision":"How should a self-guided activity use a printed prompt?","mechanism":"The sheet asks visitors to observe first, then reveals a prompt for their response."}

{"consequence":"The revisions address demonstrated points of confusion.","decision":"How should room descriptions be improved?","mechanism":"Volunteers collect repeated questions before drafting revised room descriptions."}

{"consequence":"A familiar interest provides a bridge to a new area.","decision":"How should a returning visitor find something different?","mechanism":"Reception asks which previous room the visitor enjoyed and suggests a connected object elsewhere."}

{"consequence":"The shared and local messages change together.","decision":"How should a short closing reminder reach visitors?","mechanism":"One volunteer updates the time display while the others give room reminders."}

{"consequence":"The written account develops with immediate clarification.","decision":"How should visitors share a memory linked to an exhibit?","mechanism":"Visitors and a volunteer fill out a memory card together during the conversation."}

{"consequence":"The organizer plans within visible opportunities.","decision":"How should the museum prepare for a visiting group?","mechanism":"The museum describes rooms and volunteer times before the organizer chooses a focus."}

{"consequence":"Comments are first grouped by place.","decision":"How should visitor comments be connected to places?","mechanism":"Visitors choose a room on the comment card and then describe the object or moment involved."}

{"consequence":"The change addresses an experience supported by broader records.","decision":"How should the museum choose a small improvement?","mechanism":"The team starts with repeated comments and checks room counts and observations before choosing an improvement."}
